import.title: ISDOC import
import.dropHint: Drop .isdoc, .isdocx or .zip files here (a ZIP inside a ZIP works too), or pick them.
import.limits: At most 50 MB and 500 documents at once. Issued and received documents are told apart by your company's IČO.

upload.noFiles: None of the chosen files is an .isdoc, .isdocx or .zip.
upload.tooLarge: The files are too large together (50 MB at most).
upload.tooMany: Too many documents at once (500 at most). Split the import into smaller parts.
upload.unpackedTooLarge: The unpacked archives are too large (200 MB at most). Split the import into smaller parts.
upload.category: The chosen category is no longer active. Pick another one.
upload.quotaExceeded: The PDFs of the selected documents do not fit the storage quota of the space ({detail}). Import fewer documents or delete files.

preview.empty: No ISDOC document was found in the files.

entryError.invalid_xml: The file is not a valid ISDOC document.
entryError.foreign: Your company's IČO is neither the supplier's nor the customer's.
entryError.ambiguous: Your company's IČO is both the supplier's and the customer's.
entryError.missing_field: A required element is missing (number, issue date, currency or totals).
entryError.rate_unavailable: The ČNB exchange rates are unavailable. Try the import later.
entryError.storage_unavailable: The file storage is unavailable, the PDF cannot be stored. Try the import later.
entryError.invalid_archive: The ZIP archive cannot be read (damaged, or more than 10,000 entries).
entryError.too_deep: The ZIP is nested deeper than 3 levels.
entryError.number_taken: The number from the received series is already taken. Check the counter in Settings.
entryError.quota_exceeded: The PDF does not fit the storage quota of the space.

warning.related_not_found: Original document {number} was not found; it will not be linked.
warning.pdf_skipped: The attached PDF is larger than 20 MB and will not be uploaded.
warning.rate_from_cnb: The ISDOC carries no rate; the ČNB rate will be used.
warning.contact_created: A contact will be created from the ISDOC data.

options.title: Import options
options.markPaidHint: Records a payment of the full amount on the due date (a refund for credit notes). Advance payment tax documents get none.
options.receivedHint: Applies to all selected received documents; the received date is the tax point date. Each can be edited later.

export.tooMany: More than 1000 documents match the filter. Narrow it down (e.g. by period).
export.hint: Documents that could not be exported are listed in errors.txt inside the archive.
